3. **Exact fix:** 
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Product",
  "name": "WF-1000XM5 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones",
  "brand": {
    "@type": "Brand",
    "name": "SONY"
  },
  "sku": "wf1000xm5-pzin",
  "gtin": "not found",
  "offers": {
    "@type": "Offer",
```
